This binding may modulate the activity of Gabra1, thereby influencing the overall function of the Gaba receptor. Since Gabra1 is part of the Gaba receptor activity, and this activity is participated by Gabra3, it is plausible that Heptabarbital exerts its effects on Gabra3 through a mechanism involving the activation or modulation of Gabra1. The presence of a final score of 0.677 suggests a strong, though not absolute, correlation between the two entities, supporting the hypothesis that Heptabarbital interacts with Gabra3 via the Gaba receptor pathway.
